subject: general
question: 5 men can complete a piece of work in 18 days, while 9 women can do it in 5 days. In how many days can 3 women and 3 men complete this work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = 5 Men × 18 days = 90 Men-days.

Total work = 9 Women × 5 days = 45 Women-days.

Equating both: 90 Men = 45 Women ⇒ 1 Woman = 2 Men.

Target workforce = 3 Men + 3 Women = 3 Men + 3(2 Men) = 9 Men.

Time required = Total Work ÷ Target Workforce = 90 ÷ 9 = 10 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5 men complete the work in 18 days.

9 women complete the work in 5 days.

⇒ Time taken by 1 man = 5 × 18 = 90 days.

⇒ Time taken by 1 woman = 9 × 5 = 45 days.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of 3 men = 3 × 1 = 3 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of 3 women = 3 × 2 = 6 units/day.

⇒ Combined efficiency of 3 men and 3 women = 3 + 6 = 9 units/day.

⇒ Time taken = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency = 90 ÷ 9 = 10 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Formula)

Used to solve problems involving varying workforce and hours: M₁ × D₁ × H₁ ÷ W₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂ ÷ W₂.

Work and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. Total Work = Efficiency × Time.

Pipes and Cisterns

A similar concept where an inlet pipe does positive work (+ efficiency) and an outlet pipe does negative work (− efficiency).
